actions.name: Channel Divinity
actions.desc: Turn Undead or your domain power

1.name: Spellcasting
1.desc: WIS spellcaster preparing WIS mod + cleric level spells from the cleric list each long rest; holy symbol as focus; rituals you prepared.

2.name: Channel Divinity
2.desc: Turn Undead or your domain's power, once per short rest (twice from 6th level, three times from 18th); save DC is your spell DC.

5.name: Destroy Undead
5.desc: Undead that fail against Turn Undead are destroyed if their CR is at or below the table threshold (1/2 at 5th, up to 4 at 17th).

10.name: Divine Intervention
10.desc: Action: ask your deity for help and roll d100; at or under your cleric level the DM grants a fitting miracle (then 7 days before retrying, else a long rest).

2.name: Channel Divinity: Invoke Duplicity
2.desc: Action: an illusion of you within 30 ft for 1 min (concentration); cast spells from its space, advantage on attacks vs creatures next to both of you; bonus action to move it 30 ft.

6.name: Channel Divinity: Cloak of Shadows
6.desc: Action: invisible through your next turn, ending early if you attack or cast.

8.name: Potent Spellcasting
8.desc: Add WIS to the damage of cleric cantrips.

17.name: Improved Duplicity
17.desc: Invoke Duplicity creates up to four illusions; bonus action to move any of them 30 ft.

1.name: Arcane Initiate
1.desc: Arcana proficiency and two wizard cantrips as cleric cantrips.

2.name: Channel Divinity: Arcane Abjuration
2.desc: Action: a celestial, elemental, fey or fiend within 30 ft WIS save or turned for 1 min; from 5th level low-CR ones are banished instead.

6.name: Spell Breaker
6.desc: Healing an ally with a slot also ends one spell on it of that slot level or lower.

8.name: Potent Spellcasting
8.desc: Add WIS to the damage of cleric cantrips.

17.name: Arcane Mastery
17.desc: One wizard spell each of 6th to 9th level becomes an always prepared domain spell.

1.desc: Martial weapons.

1.name: Reaper
1.desc: A necromancy cantrip from any list; single-target necromancy cantrips can hit two creatures within 5 ft of each other.

2.name: Channel Divinity: Touch of Death
2.desc: On a melee hit: +5 + twice your cleric level necrotic.

6.name: Inescapable Destruction

8.name: Divine Strike
8.desc: Once per turn a weapon hit deals +1d8 necrotic (2d8 at 14th).

1.desc: After a long rest, a nonmagical armor gets +1 AC or a weapon +1 to hit and damage until your next long rest.

2.name: Channel Divinity: Path to the Grave
2.desc: Action: curse a creature within 30 ft; the next hit on it before your next turn ends deals double damage (vulnerability).

6.name: Sentinel at Death's Door

8.name: Potent Spellcasting
8.desc: Add WIS to the damage of cleric cantrips.
